en: A colored cartoon illustration showing anthropomorphic animals around an early automobile. A bear wearing a cap and smoking a pipe stands at the left near the car's hood. A smaller animal, possibly a monkey or dog in clothes, works on the open front of the car. Another figure lies on the ground under the vehicle, apparently repairing it. On the right stands a well‑dressed female animal in a long green dress and hat, with two small white dogs nearby. The car is an old-fashioned open tourer with large padded seats and brass-colored front.
